remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS TO BE SUBMITTED BY MONDAY, JUNE 1 AT 2:00. Discover a rare opportunity at Fawn Ridge with this stunning ranch-style end unit. The main level invites you in with airy vaulted ceilings, a cozy fireplace and a striking wall of sliders that opens to an expansive 40-foot deck. At the heart of the home, the beautifully remodeled kitchen shines with quartz countertops, elegant white cabinetry and ample storage. Retreat to the primary suite, complete with triple closets, or utilize the versatile den as a comfortable guest bedroom. The fully finished lower level adds incredible value, offering a spacious secondary living area perfect for overnight guests, with a full bath and convenient laundry facilities. An attached garage is a nice feature and adds more storage space. A private end unit setting in a fabulous complex conveniently located to shopping, restaurants and major roadways. Note that the city record states 1 bedroom; however, the den has been used as a bedroom.
